title: POC 3: observe one Hermes agent completing a demo task
description: Exercise the POC with one explicitly identified Hermes session/agent and one isolated demo project. Configure the existing native Hermes MCP connection to the current Waystation executable with an explicit demo --root. Use existing get_status/get_task/get_brief, claim_task, post_message and finish_task tools: inspect a small ready fixture task, claim it, perform a harmless bounded change in the demo project, post meaningful progress and completion messages, and finish it. Manually refresh the POC 2 Monitor page at each step so the owner can follow status, ownership and discussion. Use one agent and one project only; this direct existing MCP route is not a prototype of shared-profile worker bindings or automatic dispatch. Use pre-created canonical fixture messages from another named demo participant to demonstrate an agent discussion without requiring a second live worker, and clearly distinguish fixture content from the actual Hermes-run messages. Do not use live Waystation work tasks as test fixtures or claim that the new Git reconciliation/transfer APIs exist. Record actual observed tool results and the page state, including any connection/grant blockers; do not satisfy the task by calling the tools from a different client while claiming Hermes did it.
acceptance: An actual Hermes session calls the existing Waystation MCP tools against the explicit isolated demo root and completes one claimed task with a visible progress/completion message trail.
The native POC page shows ready, in_progress with its owner, and done after manual refresh; the canonical final task, claim and messages agree with the displayed result.
The demonstration records enough evidence to distinguish seeded discussion fixtures from messages posted by the live Hermes agent; no second live worker or session-binding service is required.
Production ledgers and existing MCP entries remain intact; any dedicated demo configuration can be disabled without deleting user data.
Limitations explicitly state that this proves one direct session/project workflow, not concurrent shared-profile routing, claim transfer, new commit evidence or automatic execution.
notes: Current milestone is the proof of concept in section 0 of docs/waystation-git-hermes-implementation-plan.md. This bounded experiment does not complete or authorize the full W04-W10 implementation. Preserve the user's native Hermes app preference. No agents are dispatched by task creation. Hermes session 20261006_084801_313c3f completed the demo task through Waystation MCP tools (see integrations/hermes/poc-3-evidence.md). POC 3 remains blocked because the native Monitor was not manually refreshed to show ready, claimed, and done states during that run.
